note: Routing fixtures for the generated skill index. Level 1 names the skill, level 2 describes the task, level 3 states the goal without naming a skill. Levels 1-2 must rank the skill first; level 3 must rank it in the top two, because a goal is a wider net than a task. 'none' cases must score zero. LIMIT, stated so it is not mistaken for a guarantee: this is a vocabulary measure, not a model. It cannot tell a database table from a table for two, so the negative cases are chosen to be disjoint in wording; disambiguating homonyms is what the model-in-the-loop run is for.
